descriptions.mossNano: Compact Chinese and English preset voices and reference cloning. CPU only; normal speed.
descriptions.voxCpm2: Full precision · Voice cloning and design. Requires at least 32 GiB memory.
descriptions.voxCpm2Bf16: BF16 precision · Voice cloning and design. Requires at least 32 GiB memory.
descriptions.voxCpm2Q8: Quantized · Smaller download and disk use. Still requires at least 32 GiB memory.
descriptions.indexTts2: Q8 · Clones a recording and generates each line to its time, so dubs land without speeding up the voice. Recommended with 16 GiB memory.
descriptions.indexTts2F16: F16 · Highest IndexTTS2 fidelity, timed to each line. Recommended with 24 GiB memory.
descriptions.qwen3Tts: 1.7B Q8 · Natural cloning in ten languages; a confirmed transcript carries the reference's delivery too. Recommended with 16 GiB memory.
descriptions.qwen3TtsBf16: 1.7B BF16 · The most faithful Qwen3-TTS cloning in ten languages. Recommended with 16 GiB memory.
descriptions.qwen3TtsSmall: 0.6B Q8 · Fast cloning in ten languages for machines with 8 GiB memory.
descriptions.cosyVoice3: 0.5B Q8 · Clones a recording and follows each line's delivery instruction. Recommended with 16 GiB memory.
